data.title: Nima The Valley
data.about:
Set within the picturesque landscapes of The Valley by Emaar, Nima at the Valley emerges as an epitome of ecological sophistication. Enveloped by calm and refined neighborhoods, Nima offers a selection of spacious 3 and 4 Bedroom townhouses, presenting more than just a residence – it’s a symbiotic blend of contemporary lifestyle and nature’s tender embrace.

Nima by Emaar doesn’t just stop at the threshold of your home; it extends to tranquil waterways that beckon, forming serene pathways that don’t only connect roads but also interlink hearts. As the sun bows down, casting its golden glow over the harmonious community, it becomes evident – living in Nima at the Valley isn’t merely about inhabiting a place; it’s a journey of coming alive in unison with nature.

location_tile.title: Stay Connected and Rooted
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Perfectly situated, The Valley bridges two worlds. Within a short 25-minute journey, one can move from the bustling heart of Dubai’s Downtown to a peaceful haven on the Dubai-Al Ain Road. Revel in the balance of life, where tranquility seamlessly merges with convenience.

  • 5 mins from Rugby Sevens Stadium
  • 8 mins from Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 25 mins from Burj Khalifa & Downtown Dubai
  • 25 mins from Dubai Int’ Airport
